data.gender_notes: Ayanuth is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ayanuth is a name derived from the ancient Vedic texts. It is believed to mean 'Born from the Vedas'. In Hindu mythology, the Vedas are considered the primary source of knowledge and wisdom. Thus, the name Ayanuth signifies a deep connection to spiritual knowledge and tradition. The name Ayanuth carries the meaning “Born from the Vedas” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ayanuth usually hope their child will grow to embody born from the vedas and live with faith, good character and purpose.
